legacy_role: Versioned S0-S5 compatibility/history only; no automatic inference into this component contract.
claim_unit: logical condition for one household/site/basis at an explicit date; no monetary or energy quantity
evidence_boundary: Consumes qualified claim-specific record assertions and completion events. It does not verify original documents, calculate B12 cashflow, confer a right, or execute an action. Missing assertions are UNKNOWN; explicit negative assertions are FAIL.
time_boundary: Current assertions use explicit half-open [valid_from, valid_until) dates chosen by their qualified evidence scope; no automatic validity duration. Nonoverlapping later assertions can withdraw availability/permission. Historical accepted completion events remain available separately. Later events cannot establish an earlier snapshot.
basis_boundary: One explicit basis_id binds building/service configuration, proposed programme package/action, baseline and financial comparison scope. Facts from different bases cannot be combined. A changed configuration requires appropriately requalified assertions.

claims.HP_AVAILABLE: Accepted heat pump is available for the declared current building/service scope; historical commissioning alone is insufficient.
claims.BATTERY_AVAILABLE: Accepted battery is available at this site and date; no quantified reserve or service allocation follows.
claims.INSULATION_ADEQUATE: Declared insulation/envelope scope is currently adequate and technically accepted, including condition-appropriate openings; no generic demand-reduction waiver.
claims.HP_DESIGN_MATCH: Sizing, heat-load and emitter-temperature/service requirements match the actual declared building condition, with no universal prior insulation phase.
claims.HP_EMITTER_HYDRAULIC_READY: Required emitter and hydraulic works or evidenced existing adequacy support the proposed heat-pump commissioning.
claims.HP_ELECTRICAL_READY: The actual proposed heat-pump electrical connection and safety requirements are met.
claims.HP_SITE_REQUIREMENTS_MET: Applicable site-specific technical and permission prerequisites for the proposed heat-pump commissioning are met; a general source rule is insufficient.
claims.BATTERY_DESIGN_SAFETY_READY: Proposed battery/inverter design and installation safety requirements are met, without requiring own PV or a previously installed heat pump.
claims.BATTERY_ELECTRICAL_READY: Actual battery connection, protection and electrical prerequisites are met.
claims.BATTERY_SITE_REQUIREMENTS_MET: Applicable site-specific commissioning prerequisites are met; this does not establish any grid charging, discharge, export or aggregator operation permission.
claims.ENVELOPE_SCOPE_DESIGN_READY: Building-specific insulation and any required windows/doors are scoped; already adequate elements need no invented replacement.
claims.ENVELOPE_SITE_REQUIREMENTS_MET: Applicable site-specific prerequisites for envelope acceptance are met.
claims.PROGRAMME_ELIGIBILITY: Record-specific programme eligibility for the declared action/package is established; physical suitability is not sufficient.
claims.HOUSEHOLD_CASHFLOW_PROTECTED: Qualified full programme versus without-programme household cashflow is non-worsening from the first day and in every initial/interim/payment/settlement period on the declared basis. Includes assigned financing, operating, maintenance and replacement costs. Annual net savings or energy bills alone cannot satisfy this claim. For state/aggregator use, include household opportunity costs from foregone arbitrage, losses, wear and assigned replacement costs; scope to the exact declared operation.
claims.PROGRAMME_TECHNICAL_QA: All three named component scopes and their joint technical compatibility have independent programme technical acceptance for the actual record.
claims.UNSUBSIDIZED_TOTAL_BILL_LOWER: Total unsubsidized with-programme energy bill is strictly below the prior subsidized baseline, with compatible service, calendar, energy coverage and price basis; this is separate from full cashflow protection.
claims.SUBSIDY_EXIT_APPLICABLE: Exact replaced subsidy channel, beneficiary, payer, applicability and exit timing are qualified for this record/basis/date. Owner policy intent alone is not current legal authority or proof of released state cash.
claims.GRID_CHARGE_PERMISSION: Actual site/connection/topology permission for grid charging within the declared scope and validity period.
claims.HOUSEHOLD_DISCHARGE_PERMISSION: Actual site/connection/topology permission for household discharge within the declared scope and validity period.
claims.GRID_EXPORT_PERMISSION: Actual site/connection/topology permission for export within the declared scope and validity period; other permissions do not imply this.
claims.STATE_SERVICE_PERMISSION: Actual named state/aggregator service is authorized at this site/connection within its declared operating scope and validity; non-export service does not imply export.
claims.STATE_CONTROL_READY: The declared state/aggregator service has qualified metering, telemetry, control and applicable security prerequisites; this does not quantify callable kWh/kW or allocate capacity.

deferred: within-year scheduling and joint annual resource accounting
quantified battery dispatch and dynamic state-use allocation
subject_scope_boundary: Shared eligibility and household cashflow assertions require an explicit applies_to list of action/operation/exit subjects. Qualification for one action never widens to another. Package-wide evidence must name every covered subject explicitly. No ALL wildcard or implicit coverage.
operation_result_boundary: permission_conditions report only supplied physical and operation-right evidence; programme_preconditions additionally require subject-matched programme eligibility and household cashflow protection. Neither result is a dispatch schedule, new permission, selected work or funding.
deferred_scope: Outside this component-assessment interface; see related contracts for separate implementation status.
